data.name: Protoplasm
data.description: You can create a ball of entropic protoplasm and hurl it at targets within 30 feet. This protoplasm acts as a tanglefoot bag that also inflicts 1 point of acid damage per round to a creature entangled by it. The protoplasm dissolves within 1d3 rounds. You may use this ability %1 times per day.|Sorcerer_Protean_BloodlinePower1Times
